rows.grounds: locative of su-muhūrta indicating the proper time
absolutive expressing prior action of installation
locative of dhāman indicating the place of installation
fused form of mantrān (mantras) and tu (particle); sandhi marked in surface
prescriptive optative directing placement of the mantras

items.question: At what auspicious time and in what location must the mantras be deposited after installation?
premises: The ritual action is to occur at an auspicious moment.
The shrine is the designated location for the rite.
The mantras are to be deposited following their installation.
items.inference: Therefore, after installation at an auspicious moment in the shrine, the mantras should be ritually deposited.
items.plain_english: At an auspicious moment, having performed the installation in the shrine, one should then deposit the mantras there.
